perf_defaults.note: Compatibility defaults for legacy evaluation-policy-v1 records; not used by the eight Stage 1 problems. The judge-level perf_phase_budget_seconds is likewise legacy-only. Stage 1 problems define independent grouped cases in their fixed config.json files, and their evaluation-policy-v2 cohorts seal perf_phase_budget_seconds=0 so one case cannot consume another case's configured time allowance. Official evaluation requires a hidden PERF_SEED and seals the resolved schedule into the cohort policy; an unseeded schedule is for deterministic local development only.

timing.note: Local dev uses wall_time. Stage 1 official cohorts use in-container local-v2 perf_instructions on the pinned Linux PMU host. KTP/3 is non-official validation only. Metrics are ranked separately. Correctness and target declarations use three replays and record each median. Process startup, export parsing, and per-input dependency preload are excluded; exact output-literal checking remains included. KTP/3 binds each remote target replay to the per-problem evaluation.memory_mb bound and reports memory exhaustion during that replay as a case resource-limit outcome; official jobs instead use the per-problem evaluation.memory_mb container limit. Memory exhaustion during timed correctness replay leaves an otherwise accepted submission unscored. Other protocol or boundary versions are legacy/unscored.

scoring.contract: computation-total-v1: eight independent problem leaderboards; complete verified plans rank by T, lowest first; equal totals tie; correctness C is verification only
scoring.policy_source: evaluation/problems/<id>/config.json for all eight Stage 1 problems. The evaluation block (grouped-evaluation-v1) is sealed into each evaluation-policy-v2 cohort.
scoring.note: No points, group weights, partial rankings, or correctness-cost tie-break apply to computation-total-v1. Every official successful series retains three positive instruction samples and its exact median. Failed or unattempted cases have no median or total. Historical sealed full-plan-v1 and group-points-v1 policies retain their original semantics. Alpha and beta never affect rank. Rankings never cross problem, metric, cohort, or measurement version.
scoring.computation_total: sum(all successful target-declaration replay medians); absent unless every planned case and required verification completes
scoring.correctness_replay: full_correctness_closure_replay_median; reported separately for verification only

sandbox.note: 'none' = local dev via the landrun pass-through shim (NO sandboxing). 'container' asserts a real landrun is present and is set by the Docker image. Resource/isolation limits (memory, cpus, pids, network, non-root, kill-all-on-exit) are ENFORCED BY scripts/run_isolated.sh and the container runtime, not by the judge process. Each scored problem declares evaluation.memory_mb in its fixed config.json. The wrapper enforces that job-wide cap with zero extra swap; the judge checks the cgroup values and seals the limit into the cohort. Matrix permanent uses 8192 MiB (8 GiB); the other seven scored problems retain transitional 4096 MiB entries pending organizer confirmation. Official-host acceptance remains required for all problems. Memory changes require a new cohort and rescoring the comparison set.
